node.title: Fixed-tail quotient prefixes extend the rate-half list-unsafe slice
node.statement: For c|gcd(n,k), a fixed s-subset of one c-fiber and m=k/c+d varying full fibers produce a received word with at least ceil(C(n/c-1,m)/q^d) distinct RS[F,D,k] codewords at agreement k+dc+s. At the rate-half cap row and sigma*=8,592,912,738, c=2^22 gives the exact sufficient list-unsafe condition q^2049<2^128 C(524287,264192), extending full-band ordinary-list failure through log2(q)=255.9209759026302... . This is a list-side partial only; the top field slice and MCA band remain open.
